recipe.title: Puy lentil salad with radishes, orange and watercress
recipe.intro: April radishes are crisp, peppery and cheap, and the last of the Spanish oranges are still sweet. Together with earthy lentils they make a bright, filling spring lunch.
steps: Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry saucepan over a medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes, shaking the pan, until they puff and start to pop. Tip them onto a plate.
Put the lentils and water in the same pan, bring to the boil, then simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until tender but still holding their shape. Drain well in a sieve.
While the lentils cook, put the sliced onion in a large bowl. Squeeze over the juice of 1 orange, add the mustard, olive oil, salt and pepper and whisk. Leave the onion to soften and turn pink.
Cut the peel and white pith from the other 2 oranges, slice them into rounds, then cut each round into quarters. Slice the radishes and chop the parsley.
Tip the warm lentils into the dressing and stir. Leave for 5 minutes so they soak up the flavour.
Add the radishes, orange pieces, parsley and watercress and toss gently. Scatter over the toasted seeds and serve warm or at room temperature.
recipe.tip: Without the watercress, this keeps for 2 days in the fridge, so pack it for lunch boxes and add a handful of leaves just before eating.
